title: Babur is shown Guru Nanak's heavenly court

blocks.text: Babur is shown Guru Nanak's heavenly dharamsal, a radiant spiritual court filled with saints, holy attendants, and every sign of divine abundance. The page lingers over its trees, fragrance, pillars, and jeweled architecture to show that Guru Nanak's authority exceeds any earthly throne.

After this heavenly tour, Babur is taken onward to the enclosure associated with the Prophet, where he sees the mosque, the standard, and the gathered assembly at prayer. He is brought forward before the prophet so that he can present the desire weighing on his mind.

Babur asks for the throne of India, hoping that his petition will be granted from that court. Instead, the encounter prepares the blunt refusal that follows on the next page, where he learns that this sovereignty is not in the prophet's gift.
